summary.zh-CN: 组合条件与无条件预测实现无需外部分类器的引导。
summary.en: Combine conditional and unconditional predictions for guidance without an external classifier.

significance.zh-CN: 组合条件与无条件预测实现无需外部分类器的引导。
significance.en: Combine conditional and unconditional predictions for guidance without an external classifier.

summary.zh-CN: 利用扩散常微分方程结构减少采样步骤。
summary.en: Exploit diffusion ODE structure to reduce sampling steps.

significance.zh-CN: 利用扩散常微分方程结构减少采样步骤。
significance.en: Exploit diffusion ODE structure to reduce sampling steps.

summary.zh-CN: 研究将同一路径上的噪声样本映射到一致输出的生成模型。
summary.en: Study generative models that map points on the same trajectory to consistent outputs.

significance.zh-CN: 研究将同一路径上的噪声样本映射到一致输出的生成模型。
significance.en: Study generative models that map points on the same trajectory to consistent outputs.

summary.zh-CN: 通过误差反向传播计算网络参数梯度。此日期是代表论文发表日期，不是算法唯一的起点。
summary.en: Compute network gradients by propagating errors backward. The date identifies a landmark paper, not the sole origin of the algorithm.

significance.zh-CN: 通过误差反向传播计算网络参数梯度。此日期是代表论文发表日期，不是算法唯一的起点。

summary.zh-CN: 结合卷积、下采样与端到端训练完成文档识别。
summary.en: Combine convolution, subsampling, and end-to-end training for document recognition.

summary.en: Estimate cameras and sparse geometry from photos, connecting traditional reconstruction with neural rendering.
